title: C09 Legacy four-cache model + migration

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories not belonging to this task

acceptance_criteria: migration-notes.md explains all four legacy caches (Request Memoization, Data Cache, Full Route Cache, Router Cache), unstable_cache, and implicit fetch caching, plus WHY the model changed in Next.js 16 — with version-dated, accurate statements (QA trigger: correctness of version-specific caching facts).

A legacy variant (v15-style fetch cache options and/or unstable_cache) and a migrated 'use cache' variant of the same feature both compile and produce their documented cache behaviour (QA functional: C09 produces both a working pre-v16 variant and a working v16 variant).
The migrated variant reproduces the same observable user-facing behaviour as the legacy one, with the before/after diff explained in migration-notes.md.
cache-flow.md contains the committed cache-flow diagram comparing the legacy four-cache flow with the 'use cache' flow.

The c09 _meta folder contains spec.md (non-empty acceptance criteria), defend-it.md (3-5 from-memory questions with model answers + cache-flow diagram), verification.md, and a discoverable challenge.config.ts; data is read via a local _lib helper over lib/data without editing lib/data.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
